1.text: Ahamagara abigishwa be cumi na babiri, abaha ubutware bwo kwirukana abadayimoni no gukiza indwara zose n'ubumuga bwose.

2.text: Amazina y'intumwa cumi n'ebyiri ni aya: uwa mbere ni Simoni witwaga Petero na Andereya mwene se, na Yakobo mwene Zebedayo na Yohana mwene se,

3.text: na Filipo na Barutolomayo, na Toma na Matayo umukoresha w'ikoro, na Yakobo mwene Alufayo, na Tadayo

4.text: na Simoni Zelote, na Yuda Isikariyota ari we wamugambaniye.

5.text: Abo cumi na babiri Yesu arabatuma abategeka ati “Ntimuzajye mu bapagani cyangwa mu midugudu y'Abasamariya,

6.text: ahubwo mujye mu ntama zazimiye z'umuryango wa Isirayeli.

7.text: Nimugende mwigisha muti ‘Ubwami bwo mu ijuru buri hafi.’

8.text: Mukize abarwayi, muzure abapfuye, mukize ababembe, mwirukane abadayimoni. Mwaherewe ubusa, namwe mujye mutangira ubundi.

9.text: Ntimujyane izahabu cyangwa ifeza cyangwa amakuta mu mifuka yanyu,

10.text: cyangwa imvumba y'urugendo cyangwa amakanzu abiri, cyangwa inkweto cyangwa inkoni, kuko umukozi akwiriye ibimutunga.

11.text: “Ariko umudugudu wose cyangwa ibirorero, icyo muzajyamo, mushakemo uwo muri cyo ukwiriye, abe ari we ubacumbikira mugeze aho muzacumbukurirayo.

13.text: inzu niba ikwiriye amahoro yanyu ayizemo, ariko niba idakwiriye amahoro yanyu abagarukire.

14.text: Kandi nibanga kubacumbikira cyangwa kumva ibyo muvuga, nimuve muri iyo nzu cyangwa muri uwo mudugudu, mukunkumure umukungugu wo mu birenge byanyu.

15.text: Ndababwira ukuri yuko ku munsi w'amateka, igihugu cy'i Sodomu n'i Gomora kizahanwa igihano cyakwihanganirwa, kuruta icy'uwo mudugudu.

16.text: “Dore mbatumye muri nk'intama hagati y'amasega, nuko mugire ubwenge nk'inzoka, kandi muzabe nk'inuma mutagira amahugu.

17.text: Ariko mwirinde abantu, kuko bazabagambanira mu nkiko, kandi bazabakubitira mu masinagogi,

18.text: bazabashyīra abatware n'abami babampora, muzaba abo guhamya imbere yabo n'imbere y'abapagani.

19.text: Ariko nibabagambanira ntimuzahagarike umutima w'uko muzavuga, cyangwa ibyo muzavuga, kuko muzabibwirwa muri uwo mwanya.

20.text: Kuko atari mwe muzaba muvuga, ahubwo ari Umwuka wa So uzabavugisha.

21.text: “Umuvandimwe azagambanira mwene se ngo yicwe, na se w'umwana azamugambanira, n'abana bazagomera ababyeyi ngo babīcīshe.

22.text: Muzangwa n'abantu bose babahora izina ryanjye, ariko uwihangana akageza imperuka ni we uzakizwa.

23.text: Nibabarenganiriza mu mudugudu umwe muzahungire mu wundi. Ndababwira ukuri, yuko mutazarangiza imidugudu yose ya Isirayeli, Umwana w'umuntu ataraza.

24.text: “Umwigishwa ntaruta umwigisha, kandi n'umugaragu ntaruta shebuja.

25.text: Birahagije ko umwigishwa amera nk'umwigisha, n'umugaragu akamera nka shebuja. Niba bise nyir'urugo Belizebuli, nkanswe abari mu rugo rwe!

26.text: “Nuko ntimuzabatinye kuko ari nta cyatwikiriwe kitazatwikururwa, cyangwa igihishwe kitazamenyekana.

27.text: Ibyo mbabwirira mu mwijima muzabivugire ku mugaragaro, n'ibyo mwongorewe muzabirangururire hejuru y'amazu.

28.text: Kandi ntimuzatinye abica umubiri badashobora kwica ubugingo, ahubwo mutinye ushobora kurimburira ubugingo n'umubiri muri Gehinomu.

29.text: Mbese ibishwi bibiri ntibabigura ikuta rimwe? Ariko nta na kimwe kigwa hasi ngo gipfe, So atabizi,

30.text: ndetse n'imisatsi yo ku mitwe yanyu irabazwe yose.

31.text: Nuko ntimutinye, kuko muruta ibishwi byinshi.

32.text: “Umuntu wese uzampamiriza imbere y'abantu, nanjye nzamuhamiriza imbere ya Data uri mu ijuru.

33.text: Ariko uzanyihakanira imbere y'abantu wese, nanjye nzamwihakanira imbere ya Data uri mu ijuru.

34.text: “Mwe gutekereza ko nazanywe no kuzana amahoro mu isi. Sinaje kuzana amahoro, ahubwo naje kuzana inkota.

35.text: Kuko naje gutanya umwana na se, umukobwa na nyina, umukazana na nyirabukwe,

36.text: abanzi b'umuntu bazaba abo mu rugo rwe.

37.text: “Ukunda se cyangwa nyina kubandutisha ntaba akwiriye kuba uwanjye, kandi ukunda umuhungu we cyangwa umukobwa we kubandutisha, ntaba akwiriye kuba uwanjye.

38.text: Kandi utikorera umusaraba we ngo ankurikire, ntakwiriye kuba uwanjye.

39.text: Urengera ubugingo bwe azabubura, ariko utita ku bugingo bwe ku bwanjye, azabubona.

40.text: “Ubemera ni jye aba yemeye, kandi unyemera aba yemeye Iyantumye.

41.text: Uwemera umuhanuzi kuko ari umuhanuzi azahabwa ingororano y'umuhanuzi, kandi uwemera umukiranutsi kuko ari umukiranutsi azahabwa ingororano y'umukiranutsi.

42.text: Kandi uzanywesha umwe muri aba bato ku gacuma k'amazi akonje gusa, kuko ari umwigishwa wanjye, ndababwira ukuri yuko atazabura ingororano ye.”
